platform: Cloud SaaS and web-based ERP/LMS with native iOS and Android apps; on-premise deployment is unverified.

distinctive_features.feature: Fee workflows include seven named payment gateways, multi-account settlement, EDC reconciliation, and Tally XML synchronization.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Indian institutions can reconcile varied payment channels and route collections across branches or fee heads.

distinctive_features.feature: Automatic timetable generation supports complex constraints, conflict-aware edits, and suggested teacher substitutions.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can manage rooms, labs, electives, split sessions, and absences with less manual timetable coordination.

distinctive_features.feature: WhatsApp Business API works alongside SMS fallback, push, email, and branded mobile apps.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can reach families through familiar channels and track delivery across communication methods.

distinctive_features.feature: Report cards support CBSE, ICSE, IB, IGCSE, Cambridge, and major state-board formats.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools with different curricula can configure assessment outputs within one platform.

distinctive_features.feature: Transport includes live GPS, ETA, boarding and alighting alerts, and route-level billing.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Families and transport teams can monitor journeys and connect route operations with charges.

distinctive_features.feature: The AI assistant surfaces fee dues, attendance dips, admissions bottlenecks, and exam outliers, and drafts reminders.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Administrators can identify operational exceptions and prepare routine communications, though public technical validation is limited.

distinctive_features.feature: A drag-and-drop report builder supports exports, scheduled delivery, and direct API access for BI tools.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Management teams can tailor reporting and transfer data into external analytics workflows.

distinctive_features.feature: College workflows advertise CBCS, AICTE, UGC, and NAAC-oriented reporting.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Higher-education institutions can use ERP workflows aligned with common Indian academic and accreditation requirements.

weaknesses.issue: Pricing is quote-only; the published ₹0–₹250 range is an older general-market estimate, not a Skolaro tariff.
Apple reviewers report missing notifications, poor performance, and difficulty viewing or downloading PDFs.
Google Play reviews report persistent loading and links that fail to open.
Independent review evidence is thin, limiting external assessment of usability and implementation outcomes.
AI, adoption, outcome, and compliance claims lack extensive public technical documentation or independent validation.
UDISE+, APAAR, NEP holistic cards, DPDP readiness, and special-education capabilities are not publicly evidenced.
Google Play says data is not encrypted and cannot be deleted, conflicting with vendor privacy-policy statements.
No public OneRoster, LTI, Ed-Fi, SSO, or developer documentation was found.

ai_features: Assistant surfaces fee dues, attendance dips, admissions bottlenecks, and exam outliers.
AI-drafted fee reminders are described; a public technical model card is unavailable.
pricing_model_summary: Per-student pricing, billed annually or term-wise; quote-based with no public price card. Vendor says base pricing includes modules, implementation, training, and migration; unusual customization costs extra.
biggest_strategic_gap: Limited public evidence for standards-based interoperability, specialized safeguarding and special-education workflows, and India-specific compliance such as UDISE+, APAAR, and DPDP readiness.
